events.headline: IRAN WARNS OF 'FASTER, HEAVIER, MORE PAINFUL RESPONSE' TO US ATTACKS
events.detail: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.
